result: JettyMetricsBridgePrototypeTest inserts a test-only EventsHandler into JettySolrRunner, sends an outside-context PUT before the metrics bridge is registered, then registers observable request/status counters and a pool gauge in SolrMetricManager and checks its Prometheus reader. No production handler or packaging changes. This is an unrun hypothesis, not a viability proof. Classloader and distribution integration, comprehensive methods and statuses, async and early startup are not proven.
